title: Timothy T NDE 2735
content: I was living with a girl who I loved very much. We had moved recently because of an earlier attack on us by two guys. I was able to fight them off that time. But three to four months later, her ex-boyfriend tried to kill me with a crossbow but missed. Then a couple months later, I came home from work to find two guys in my apartment weighing drugs on my table. When I asked what the hell they doing in my place my girlfriend came out of the bedroom with one guy and said, 'I let them in.' After seeing that I became very angry and threw the drugs on the floor. They said, 'That was it! You f**ked up cracker!' They chased me outside to the parking lot where one of them came at me swinging a sword. I had thought he cut my fingers off but when I looked, I had caught the sword with my hands and kicked him in the chest somehow knocking him down. Just when that happened, I heard a kind of drumming on my head. I fell to my knees to see what was causing it. The pounding started again and that's when the pain was so bad I could not take any more pain. Blackness, and then I was looking at someone lying on the ground in the parking lot with three guys standing over him; one with a sword; one with a bat; one with a gun. And I thought, 'Hey what's going on? That's me down there.' I was rising above the buildings and trees. Just then, a Large Hand came and held my hand and then I saw HIM He was bright and had beautiful features, long silver hair and beard, along with bright never-ending gown. He didn't say a word but I heard, 'It's okay. We are going home.' Next, there was a field on the right with people working in it harvesting some kind of grain. Next to the left, there was shops and a street that was beautiful and bright. Something else I saw, benches, like bus stop benches, that was weird. Then I heard the most calming and peaceful voice saying to me. It's Not My Time Yet! Somewhere along this journey, there had been a kind of screaming and kicking going on within me. I was saying, NO, NO, NO. I can't leave without saying goodbye to my family, I love them, please NO. Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 8/10/1991 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Criminal attack Direct head injury 'Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening' This is hard to explain. I was attacked by three men who were armed. How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I lost awareness of my body How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? Normal consciousness and alertness At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I don't understand. It was the minute I left my body I guess. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. When the hand came out of nowhere I felt at ease, calm. The voice saying it's not my time yet. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes The Large being was on my left and was holding my hand. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place A street with shops on the left and a field of gold grain with benches What emotions did you feel during the experience? Pain at first. Then afraid of being left alone. Then love and anger. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? Neither Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? Neither Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? A barrier I was not permitted to cross; or 'sent back' to life involuntarily God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Iam not religious went to church as a child Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes Very much so. Not afraid to die. I know where I'll be going, I'm not alone. What is your religion now? Moderate 'I am not religious , but saved by grace from my Creator i still go to church sometimes' Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Very much so. Not afraid to die. I know where I'll be going, I'm not alone. Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes My selfish needs and thoughts are not important. That though life is hard we have someone to hold our hand. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Because I did not know how to say (I don't want to go away from loved ones). Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes That there is nothing to fear in death. I mostly come in contact with older adults. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? That someone was holding my hand and walking with me through this. That love is a power that knows no boundary even in death. (The hair on my neck and arms just stood up, wow!) Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Three years. Oh they had no idea that really happened to me. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? Uncertain My mother told me a story. No but I believe in hell now. What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real After three or four days something just felt different. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real It was my experience and only mine. I am a unique person. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No Is there anything else that you would like to add about your experience? FORGIVENESS that's what it's all about. Are there any other questions that we could ask to help you communicate your experience? It's kind of weird but my experience is very different. Right.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: He observed his body on the ground in the parking lot with three men standing over it, then rose above buildings and trees.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Initial severe pain, then blackness; later relief/calm when the hand appeared.

arrival.other_being_detail: A bright male-presenting being with long silver hair and beard and a bright never-ending gown; also a 'Large Hand' that held his hand.

environment.environment_other_detail: Field of people harvesting grain on the right; shops and a bright street on the left; benches like bus-stop benches.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Criminal attack with weapons; direct head injury implied by 'pounding' and severe pain before blackness.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Prior: 'not religious went to church as a child'; After: 'saved by grace from my Creator' and goes to church sometimes.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Large Hand holding his hand; internal 'screaming and kicking' and pleading not to leave without saying goodbye to family.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE to meeting a hand/being, then journey through a bright street/field scene, then boundary/return message ('It's Not My Time Yet').

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Benches 'like bus stop benches' in the unearthly street/field scene; a separate 'Large Hand' holding his hand before seeing the bright being; internal 'screaming and kicking' and pleading not to leave.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: 'It's okay. We are going home.'; 'It's Not My Time Yet!'
